source: The brain-map.org taxonomy page given in each entry's url
notes: This catalog is deliberately limited to these eight taxonomies. Add a taxonomy here, not in a prompt.
ait_ids are the Allen Institute Taxonomy numbers shown on each taxonomy's brain-map.org page; ait_ids_by_species gives the per-species number for multi-species taxonomies.
regions holds anatomical terms only; scripts/ait_taxonomy.py matches them against a paper's regions.

Not re-confirmed against brain-map.org on the snapshot date: the Comparative LGN CCN (null), the Whole Mouse Brain Consensus publication line, and the mapmycells flags other than those of the Whole Mouse Brain Consensus and Cross-Species Basal Ganglia taxonomies.

taxonomies.title: Whole Mouse Brain Consensus (AIT33)
taxonomies.hierarchy: 9 neighborhoods / 43 classes / 414 subclasses / 1,386 supertypes / 6,721 clusters; integrates the Allen Institute scRNA-seq (AIT21) and Broad Institute snRNA-seq whole mouse brain taxonomies

taxonomies.title: Cross-Species Basal Ganglia Taxonomy (AIT19.5, AIT11.9, AIT101)
taxonomies.hierarchy: >2M nuclei, 10x multiome + ATAC + spatial + morphology/ephys; ~60 homologous types aligned to mouse and human whole-brain atlases; refined MSN/GABAergic taxonomy
taxonomies.publication: Johansen N.J., Fu Y., Schmitz M. et al., Cross-species consensus atlas of the primate basal ganglia, bioRxiv (2025) doi:10.64898/2025.12.15.694496

taxonomies.title: Human MTG SMART-Seq Taxonomy (AIT15.3)
taxonomies.publication: Hodge R.D., Bakken T.E. et al., Nature 573:61-68 (2019)

taxonomies.title: Comparative Lateral Geniculate Nucleus Taxonomy (AIT102, AIT103, AIT104)
taxonomies.hierarchy: Cross-species SMART-seq dLGN taxonomy; 1,209 human nuclei, 2,157 macaque nuclei, 2,190 mouse cells
taxonomies.publication: Bakken T.E., van Velthoven C., Menon V. et al., eLife 10:e64875 (2021)

taxonomies.title: Mammalian Primary Motor Cortex Taxonomy
taxonomies.hierarchy: >3M cells profiled across modalities and species (BICCN flagship)
taxonomies.publication: BICCN, Nature (2021) — Bakken T.E. et al. and companion papers

taxonomies.title: Human Neocortex Taxonomy (AIT105)
taxonomies.hierarchy: 49,495 SMART-seq nuclei across MTG, ACC, V1C, M1C, S1C, A1C; 24 consistent subclasses
taxonomies.publication: Jorstad N.L. et al., Science 382 (2023) doi:10.1126/science.adf6812

taxonomies.title: Mouse Isocortex & Hippocampal Formation Taxonomy (AIT5.1)
taxonomies.hierarchy: 388 transcriptomic types (364 neuronal) from ~1.3M cells profiled with 10x and SMART-seq
